generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The `extractSuffixMaps` method does not handle the case where a path element is an empty string. This can happen if there are consecutive dots in the path (e.g., "a..b"). The method should either throw an exception or ignore such cases.

The validation in `doValidate` method assumes that the parent object mapper's name is exactly one level above the current field. However, if there are nested objects, this assumption may not hold true. The code should traverse up the hierarchy to find the nearest parent object mapper with subobjects enabled.

review_comment:
We got a two-for-one with this bug fix 😁 

Since the semantic text field type adds sub-objects to the mapping upon first document ingestion, it cannot be in an object field with subobjects disabled. Before this fix, doing so resulted in Very Bad Things™, such as the [document parser handling inference sub-fields as runtime fields and triggering assertion failures](https://github.com/Mikep86/elasticsearch/blob/516aa119453d97ec7ac58292e8a91642a5d75893/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/DocumentParser.java#L1039-L1039).
